svg.text: rise and set of sun and moon, civil twilight · times in UTC
ALL TIMES IN UTC, in four figures; a dash when the body does not rise or set that day. In British Summer Time add 1 hour; French legal time is UTC+1, UTC+2 in summer.
SUN: rise and set of its upper limb, with mean refraction (−0°50′). TWILIGHT: civil, the sun 6° below the horizon; dawn is when it begins, dusk when it ends.
MOON: rise and set of its upper limb, with its parallax. ● new · ◐ first quarter · ○ full · ◑ last quarter, on the day they fall. Sundays shaded.
For 51° 07.0′ N, 001° 19.0′ E. ELSEWHERE, BY LONGITUDE: add 4 minutes to every time for each degree further west, take them off for each degree further east (measured on this page's sun).
Worked out with the same function the course checker uses for daylight (Meeus), checked against the US Naval Observatory. Not for navigation.
